title: Website Design
menuDescription: Clear, responsive interfaces shaped around your brand and customer journey.
summary: Design a clear, responsive website that reflects your brand and guides customers toward the right action.

overview.title: Turn your website into a useful part of the customer journey.
paragraphs: We map the decisions your visitors need to make, then shape the content, navigation, and interface around those decisions.
The result is a practical design system your team can build, maintain, and extend without losing consistency.

features.title: Customer journey planning
features.description: Content and navigation organized around real visitor questions and business goals.

features.title: Responsive interface systems
features.description: Layouts designed to remain clear and usable across desktop, tablet, and mobile.

features.title: Accessible interactions
features.description: Readable hierarchy, keyboard support, and interface states considered from the start.

features.title: Content hierarchy
features.description: A page structure that makes important information easy to scan and understand.

features.title: Brand integration
features.description: Typography, color, imagery, and components brought together into one coherent visual language.

features.title: Build-ready handoff
features.description: Documented screens, components, and responsive behavior ready for engineering.

banner.title: Need a website that works as clearly as your business does?
banner.description: Tell us what your customers need to understand and what your team needs the site to accomplish.

faqs.question: How long does a website design engagement take?
faqs.answer: Timing depends on the number of pages, content readiness, and review process. We confirm the scope and delivery plan after discovery so your team has a realistic schedule.

faqs.question: Can ASTA also build the website?
faqs.answer: Yes. Design and development can be delivered as one engagement, or we can prepare a build-ready design system for your internal or partner engineering team.

faqs.question: How are design revisions handled?
faqs.answer: We agree on review points before work begins. Feedback is grouped by milestone so decisions stay clear and revisions remain tied to the approved goals.

faqs.question: Do we need finished content before starting?
faqs.answer: Not always. Early content direction is useful, but we can begin with structure and priority. Final copy and imagery should be available before the final design pass.

faqs.question: What do you need from our team?
faqs.answer: We usually need a business overview, target users, brand materials, current pain points, and access to relevant analytics or customer feedback when available.
